title: executive-daily-priorities-morgan-2026-03-10
content:
Daily priorities — Morgan — 2026-03-10

Top 3 (fix these first)
1) Finalize Dedicated capacity commit language for Acme pitch (send to legal + sales by EOD) — need final numbers from finance (Ravi).
2) Leadership sync prep (10:00) — short deck + 3 asks for GTM and Eng: a) beta customers for Dedicated, b) SLA wording, c) decision on burst policy defaults.
3) Review Optimize pilot results (internal) — identify 2 low-risk knobs to push to reduce token cost by ~15%.

Calendar / Blocks
- 08:30 — quick inbox sweep, triage high-priority flags
- 09:00 — 1:1 w/ Elena (30m) — topics: Dedicated rollout timeline, hiring update for solutions eng (2 heads), delegation for QBR exec slides
- 10:00 — Leadership sync (30m) — run deck, keep to 15m updates, 15m decisions
- 11:00 — Customer QBR prep w/ CS (Isabella) — finalize metrics and follow-ups
- 14:00 — Call with Acme procurement (30m) — price & SLA negotiation; ask for 90-day pilot
- 15:00 — Deep work: Optimize pilot analysis (1.5h)
- 17:00 — End-of-day check-in, send follow-ups

Meeting prep notes
- Leadership sync:
  - Slide 1: 30k ft priorities (Q2 revenue target, Dedicated GTM milestones)
  - Slide 2: current capacity burn + predicted delta with Optimize knobs
  - Slide 3: asks (see Top 3) + risk table (supply constraints, model migration risk)
  - Ask PMs to keep updates to 2 bullets each

- Acme call:
  - Primary goal: lock 90-day pilot commitment with defined success metrics (latency SLA, throughput, data handling)
  - Backup: offer discounted month with Dedicated reserved units if pilot not allowed
  - Bring: sample SLA wording (legal has draft INF-SLA-v2)

Follow-ups / action items (from prior days)
- [ ] Ravi: confirm finance numbers for Dedicated reserve options (due today)
- [ ] Elena: share final hire req for solutions eng (due tomorrow)
- [x] Isabella: send QBR metrics draft (sent 2026-03-09)
- [ ] Infrastructure: validate burst capacity test plan (need results by Fri)
- [ ] PM: finalize feature list for Optimize UI change (blockers: UX review)

Notes to self / quick brain dump
- Push for clearer cost tradeoff page in Console (per-route token breakdown). This will reduce sales friction.
- Consider a short internal FAQ for Dedicated vs Hosted API to speed SDR responses. Draft bulleted page.
- Evaluate ability to offer short-term reserved capacity (30-day) as a bridging product — check infra complexity.

Risk / open questions
- If Nvidia drivers delay on specific host types, what's fallback? How automated is model routing to alternate hardware? Need one-sentence status from infra.
- Legal: any redlines expected from enterprise customers on data handling re: Private deployments? Get checklist from security/compliance.

Weekly goals (week of 2026-03-09)
- Close 2 pilot commitments (Acme prioritized)
- Put Optimize initial knobs into prod for 3 internal customers
- Hire: get two offers accepted for solutions eng

Quick links (for meetings)
- Q2 roadmap (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood-inference.com/display/OPS/Q2+Roadmap
- Dedicated pricing doc (internal): INF-2345 (Jira)
- Console PR to review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482

Shorthand TODOs (fast notes)
- email legal re: INF-SLA-v2 + any required clause for privacy shield
- ask infra for fallback routing status (1-2 sentence)
- set calendar block Fri 11:00 for Optimize rollout retro

Random thoughts (not for others)
- Need a short 1-pager for execs comparing hosting options and expected unit economics — will draft after Optimize analysis
- If we standardize default burst policy to X, will reduce decision friction for sales but could increase infra ops noise — quantify tradeoff next week

End-of-day deliverables (what I should have sent)
- Updated asks doc to leadership (email + attach 1-pg)
- Send Acme pilot terms to procurement (cc: legal)
- Close loop w/ Finance on Dedicated numbers

---
Notes and fragments captured here; messy, actionable. Keep this as working scratchpad.
